method: Built-in ImageGen; two sheets, five teachers and six frames per teacher
prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art fighting game sprite sheet for Ikemen. Reference image is ONLY a character identity/style guide showing ten teachers in labeled rows; generate NEW poses. Exact output layout: SIX equal columns and FIVE equal rows, 30 complete full-body sprites, only ONE character per row, each row a 6-frame animation from left to right. Actual transparent background, no labels, no lettering, no grid, no shadows on ground, no opponent. Every frame must stay inside its own cell with generous transparent gutters, head/body scale constant across all frames, no cropping of feet or raised hands. Consistent side-view facing right, crisp arcade pixel art, same faces, clothing and body proportions as reference. Do not copy the source collage layout. Canvas portrait, approximately 1536 wide and 1280 tall. Each figure about 180 pixels tall, matched body scale, feet baseline stable within row. Rows in exact order, using reference's TOP FIVE teachers. Row 1 CHAN: woman with long black hair and glasses, black blouse and jeans, six-frame kettlebell clean and press: brace, bend with weight, lift to waist, lift to chest, extend weight with arm, settle. Row 2 FELIX: grey-haired man blue polo and dark jeans, six-frame defensive repair stance: glance at diagnostic wrist, crouch guard, block with both forearms, wind up elbow, sharp elbow counter to the right, recover. Row 3 ALEJANDRO: young man red plaid open overshirt grey T-shirt olive trousers, six-frame import module preparation: reach into pocket, inspect small red code cube in palm, rotate cube, align both hands, finish inspecting, put cube away. NO projectiles. Row 4 DANIELA: woman shoulder-length dark hair black T-shirt jeans black heels and handbag, six-frame paperwork parry: take document from bag, read document, lift document and handbag as guard, deflect attack with bag, firm corrective palm gesture to the right, recover. Row 5 GAMEROS: young long dark-haired man black hoodie olive pants, six-frame gym warm-up dancing boxer stance: bounce, shoulder roll, switch weight, squat slightly, flex arms, settle into boxing guard. No motorbike, no gamepad.
